title: AI engine configuration
description: Providers, the model catalog and each task's per-provider model chain (config/ai-engines.json, #1973). scripts/validate-ai-engines.py checks this schema and the rules it cannot express: chains name only catalogued, non-retired models of their own provider; every model of an enabled provider has a price row; duck, fable and Copilot chains hold one model.

version.description: Format version. Bump it on an incompatible change to this schema.

models.description: The model catalog, keyed by model id as the provider's API spells it.

fallback_order.description: The default order across providers: the first is the primary, the rest are tried in turn (the AI_ENGINES default).

duck.description: The model used when a provider is the rubber duck (one model). A provider left out follows its triage chain's first model.

fable.description: Claude's fable family key: the id ai_model_for_family fable returns (one model). No engine task runs it.

modelId.description: The model id pattern engine-models.sh accepts.

status.description: active and preview models may appear in a chain; retired ones may not.

chain.description: Ordered model ids: the primary first, then the fallbacks tried on a rate limit.

task.description: Per provider, the task's model chain. A provider left out has no default chain for the task.

prefer.description: Reserved for per-task provider preference (a later phase of #1973). Accepted, not read.
